releases.name: Ice Files 2026-11-09
releases.body: Created Ice Files, a novelty member ID maker for field agents of a frozen drink company. You fill in your details and add a photo, and it builds a card with a front and a back. Added a his or her choice, a license back for each persona, and a fix for phone screens that clipped the card.

jobs.description: A novelty agent ID card maker with photo, license classes, and front and back export

releases.name: LV Liquor Intel 2026-11-09
releases.body: Created LV Liquor Intel, a map of liquor sellers in Las Vegas, Paradise, and Henderson, with a first version and a faster second one. Markers are colored for standalone liquor stores, casino and resort liquor, and bars. Version four loads its data through a server route that tries several data mirrors at once and never keeps an empty result.

jobs.description: A Las Vegas map of liquor stores, casino bars, and bars with filters and CSV export

releases.name: Lenticular Tilt 2026-11-09
releases.body: Created Lenticular Tilt, a phone toy that turns three photos into a tilting lenticular picture.

jobs.description: A phone toy that blends three photos into a tilting lenticular picture

releases.name: Scorpion Supper 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added Scorpion Supper version seven, an endless growth eater with coyotes and coops. You steer a scorpion on an open range and eat to grow, and the world scales up as you do.

jobs.description: An endless arcade game where a scorpion eats to grow and hides from coyotes

releases.name: Strudel Samples 2026-11-09
releases.body: Created a sample pack for the Strudel music tool, with a map that lets Strudel load clips straight from this repo. Added short spoken clips and a puller script that fetches them, with a run log and a fallback when the first host fails. Candidate clips were sorted, trimmed, and joined into the final set.

releases.name: Agent Test Bed 2026-11-10
releases.body: The agent turn for the day was played and merged into the city.

jobs.description: A shared city that AI agents build one turn at a time

releases.name: Road Layers 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added a Music tab to Road Layers. It finds kick, snare, and hi-hat hits in a song, and cutouts pop in on the hits with the song playing in the composite and in recordings. Play and pause are more reliable, dragging to pan no longer pulls you back, and each kind of cutout gets a color coded drum.

jobs.description: Road Layers stacks cars from several drive clips onto one road in the browser.

releases.name: Parcelsun 2026-11-09
releases.body: Parcelsun version five adds a layout editor in the 3D model, door numbers shown on the doors, and a door numbers card with per column numbering, a skipped starter, and door search. Added version four and version five styles, Q units, and outside and inside corners.

jobs.description: A solar heat model for a parcel locker with a four module default.

releases.name: Smash Bender 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added a chop tool that cuts a slice from a sample, reads its notes, and writes Strudel code with a link to open it. Chop timing is exact, the notes are cleaner, and the original slice plays in sync under the notes. The sample log can chop any sample into notes, save a slice to GitHub, and add a sound clip. A publish endpoint sends clips to the Strudel sample repo.

jobs.description: A processing server for song mashups with phone scripts

releases.name: Stompbox Lab 2026-11-09

jobs.description: A pedal board and synth with grooves that play across many phones.

releases.body: Added a train window scene to the wall, where Stompbox notes and pedals become passing scenery.

jobs.description: A visualizer pedal where a pixel crow flies across phones lined up side by side

releases.name: Mill-ionaire 2026-11-09
releases.body: Added filament printers. A plastic 3D printer takes a floor bay and prints letters, numbers and emoji in white, black, red, blue or yellow filament, the color of whatever spool it has loaded. Owning one brings in orders in filament colors that only a printer can make. Thin parts like a 1 print fast and a fat 8 or an emoji takes longer, a printer works the colors already on its spool first, a different color means an operator swaps the spool, and now and then a print turns to spaghetti and gets scraped off the bed. Tapping a printer opens a keypad that prints any part ahead into the bins in the picked spool color, and orders take from the bins first.

jobs.description: A letter shop tycoon built around a simulated knee mill that grows into a factory.
